ROTKISKE v. KLEMM et al.
589 U.S. 8
No. 18-328.
Argued October 16, 2019.
Decided December 10, 2019.
JUSTICE THOMAS delivered the opinion of the Court.
We hold that, absent the application of an equitable doctrine, the statute of limitations in § 1692k(d) begins to run on the date on which the alleged FDCPA violation occurs, not the date on which the violation is discovered.
Rotkiske urges us to read a discovery rule into the provision. We decline. It is a fundamental principle of statutory interpretation that absent provisions cannot be supplied by the courts.
